items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Jack, Jack Lee and them was running, uh, couch games up there

ctx.x: Took everything you were from. Bradley did that. He's dead and gone. But he was, oh, he was a terrible fellow. Well, who was Dutch Cromer? Do you remember Dutch Cromer, policeman? Yeah, Cromer. I believe. Now, Cromer was a, he used to be,

it used to be detailed too, around that battlefield. He was a mounted officer too. But he was afraid of them guards back there. What about Bohog? Do you remember Bohog? Bohog was, uh, uh, he was, well, he was, uh, he came up from around, uh, Franklin Street. Mm-hmm. Up around that territory. That's where they come from. Around that way, uh, Jack, Jack Lee and them was running, uh, couch games up there, right? That was a district around, on Grabview between Franklin and Saratoga. That was a red light district.…
I know what you mean, right? Basin Street. Basin Street. And there was Gasket Street. Yeah.
